title: Mientras dure la tormenta: simultaneidad y matices durativos
goal: Deploy 'mientras' and 'entre tanto' across indicative and subjunctive to express durative simultaneity, contrast, and prospective conditions.
grammar: Simultaneidad y duración: los múltiples valores de mientras

sections.title: Unit 7: Temporal Subordination — Lesson 3
body: Welcome to lesson 3 of Unit 7 (Temporal Subordination & Future Prospections). Mastering the boundary between indicative and subjunctive in temporal clauses is a hallmark of upper-intermediate fluency.
In this lesson, we analyze mientras dure la tormenta: simultaneidad y matices durativos, establishing precise temporal coordination across complex sentences.

items: Deploy 'mientras' and 'entre tanto' across indicative and subjunctive to express durative simultaneity, contrast, and prospective conditions.
Incorporate advanced temporal vocabulary (la simultaneidad, paralelo).
